svg.title: Approve, transferFrom and revoke
svg.desc: Five steps: A calls approve(B,500), allowance 500, balances unchanged; B calls burnFrom(A,100), allowance 400; B calls transferFrom moving 100 to B, allowance 300; B calls transferFrom moving 200 from A to A, allowance 100; A calls approve(B,0), allowance 0.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Approval ≠ payment: the life of allowance(A, B)

svg.text: approve only sets the most B may move; balances change only when B calls burnFrom / transferFrom.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A new approve replaces the old amount. To revoke: approve(spender, 0), then wait until mined.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif
